audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Levels 2, 3 and First item to Vladimir while the matching 'why' on each of those rows describes Neeko chunking him, killing him, and out-pacing his sustain. breakdown.mid literally says 'This is your lane.'
audit.why: phases[1..5].side / win[1..5] contradict whys[1..5] and the packet chart [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Vladimir]. Win rate 57.14% over 14 games. Vlad has no escape until W is pointed and no pre-6 kill pressure on a 800/1000-range poke kit.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Neeko, row 6 stays Vladimir, row 0 stays Skill — proposed as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item, 2+ items (Vlad's window). Correctly identifies that the hand-off is Rylai's/second AP item, matching Crimson Pact's HP-to-AP conversion.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls Sanguine Pool a 'fifteen-second invitation'. It is 28/25/22/19/16s — 28s at rank 1, and never 15.
audit.why: enemyKit W: cd 28/25/22/19/16, 2 seconds untargetable, 350 range. Writing the real number makes the bait-then-commit rule actionable instead of vague.
audit.corrected: Use 28s rank 1 and state the 2-second untargetable duration in the do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only once, buried in report[8]; the content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds despite Vlad healing off both Transfusion (Q) and Hemoplague (R).
audit.why: Transfusion carries the heal flag and is a 4.6s cooldown at rank 5 with zero cost; Hemoplague heals per champion hit. Extended trades are decided by whether Grievous Wounds is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text says you can ult 'invisible off W'. Riot's W description grants a clone, bonus damage and move speed — no invisibility.
audit.why: Left the strings alone rather than rewrite on an unverified mechanic; logged as unverified.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Two seconds untargetable on a 28s cooldown at rank 1 — bait it, then spend your kill window inside that gap.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — that is a 28s invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: You out-trade a pre-Rylai Vlad — bait the pool, then E-root and Q-poke on its long cooldown while his drains cannot keep pace.
edits.after: You out-trade a pre-Rylai Vlad — bait Sanguine Pool, then E-root and Q-poke through its 28s gap; buy anti-heal early.

notes: Chart rows 1-5 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group. Unverified and left alone: the claim that Neeko's W grants invisibility (whys[4], mid, spikes[1] context) — Riot's W text describes a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, with no stealth flag on the ability. If Neeko's W does grant camouflage in-game, several matchups in this champion depend on it and it should be confirmed once at the champion level rather than per matchup.
